Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Porsche Cayenne Turbo Electric, and he’s about to see if the most powerful Porsche ever is truly deserving of so much power. 

For starters, let’s check out the design… 

From the front, it’s fair to say that the exterior design is an improvement over the old petrol-powered Cayenne! It has real presence when looking at it from the front, with aggressive air scoops on either side, while the Turbo edition has further vents and air intakes across the bumper. Along the side, there are wider surrounds on the wheel arches, and the Turbo edition we’re reviewing has a grey satin effect on the roof bars and window surrounds.
